goal: Prove the completed pipeline detail route family passes current focused/full frontend validation and equivalent-state production-versus-prototype browser review across desktop/mobile, theme, locale, and permission boundaries.
non_goals: Do not edit production frontend, router runtime, API, store, backend, persistence, dependencies, authentication, permission calculation, locales, or the approved prototype.
Do not change router assertions or production behavior; the only web edit allowed is an explicit timeout for the existing dynamic-import router tests.
Do not add routes, fields, states, mutations, compatibility behavior, or prototype-only data.
Do not reuse earlier screenshots or reports as evidence for the current commit.
Do not claim later route families, global accessibility/internationalization/responsive closure, or all 67 route rows are complete.
expected_evidence: Current focused eight-file pipeline Vitest and complete frontend Vitest receipts.
Targeted pipeline Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff receipts.
Durable production and approved-prototype screenshots at 1600x1000 and 390x844 for dark Simplified Chinese and representative light English states.
Browser measurements for terminal route, viewport, screenshot dimensions, theme, language, colors, page/dense-container overflow, permissions, i18n leakage, and console/runtime/network errors.
A task-local replayable Mock API harness and evidence manifest tied to the current Git commit.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent spec and quality reviews for baseline task 3.5.
unsafe_assumptions: Previous screenshots, green tests, CSS classes, or source tokens do not prove current rendered behavior.
Production and prototype evidence is comparable only when route family, viewport, theme, locale, permission role, and populated-data state are normalized.
Pixel identity is not required when hierarchy, behavior, responsive containment, and semantic tokens satisfy the approved contract.
Prototype-only values must not be copied into production or treated as supported backend fields.
stop_condition: Stop before any production edit. If current rendered evidence exposes a defect, record it, expand allowed files through Scope Lock, rerun development entry, and add a focused failing regression before repair.
